TECHNICAL OVERVIEW

Technical specifications

Select the response type and required overall length, then specify the connection and escutcheon. Overall length refers to the complete assembly.

Product specifications
Product type
Dry Pendent Fire Sprinkler
Installation
Pendent only
Nominal connection
DN15 / ½ in
K-factor
K5.6 US / K80 metric
Response options
Standard response, 5 mm bulb; quick response, 3 mm bulb
Temperature rating
68°C / 155°F, red glass bulb
Standard overall lengths
100 mm / 3.94 in; 145 mm / 5.71 in
Minimum overall length
80 mm / 3.15 in
Length definition
End-to-end overall length of the complete product
Frame material
Stainless steel
Frame finish
Chrome-plated
Max. working pressure
1.2 MPa / 12 bar / approx. 175 psi
Configuration status
Custom overall length
Available from an 80 mm minimum; final dimensions are confirmed against the approved drawing or order.
Escutcheon
Configurations with and without an escutcheon are shown. Final trim dimensions are confirmed with the selected length.
Thread form
Available on request and confirmed against the customer drawing or approved sample.
Design note
System type, installation environment, minimum temperature and project suitability must be confirmed against the exact technical documentation.

حالة التكوين
طول كلي مخصص
متوفر بدءاً من حد أدنى ⁦80 mm⁩؛ تُؤكد الأبعاد النهائية وفق الرسم أو الطلب المعتمد.
حلقة التغطية
تُعرض تكوينات مع حلقة تغطية وبدونها. تُؤكد الأبعاد النهائية للتجهيزات مع الطول المختار.
نوع السن اللولبي
متوفر عند الطلب ويُؤكد وفق رسم العميل أو العينة المعتمدة.
ملاحظة تصميمية
يجب تأكيد نوع النظام وبيئة التركيب والحد الأدنى لدرجة الحرارة وملاءمة المشروع وفق الوثائق الفنية المحددة.

SPECIFICATIONS

Product selection details

Compare the body configurations and connection references below. Construction and performance details are confirmed for your selected configuration with the quotation.

Product family

Available configurations
Straight-through · oblique threaded · oblique flanged
Catalog inlet options
2.5 in NPT / BSP / BSPT / BS4504
Catalog common outlet
2.5 in BS336
Selection references
HS-031 · HS-011 · HS-012 · HS-013 · HS-020
Connection customization
BSP and BSPT options available; custom connections on request

1.6 MPa / 16 bar; 2.5 MPa / 25 bar
